Enhance your vintage collection or utility display with this unique lot of 3 antique electrical insulators. Durable and historically significant, these insulators served as essentials in early telegraph and power lines. Perfect for repurposing, educational displays, or collectors, these authentic pieces come from trusted American manufacturers and offer both nostalgia and craftsmanship. Their robust construction ensures longevity for decorative or practical reuse. All pieces are original, showing minor wear consistent with age, adding to their authenticity.

A pair of vintage corncob tobacco pipes manufactured by the Missouri Meerschaum Company of Washington, Missouri. Founded in 1869, Missouri Meerschaum is the world's oldest and largest manufacturer of corncob pipes, known for their cool-smoking properties and historical significance in American culture. These two examples feature different bowl textures and stem designs, ideal for collectors or enthusiasts of traditional smoking implements.

Wood stems are secure. Plastic mouthpieces are intact without significant bite marks or cracks. Base label on one pipe is present and legible with minor edge wear. Generally well-preserved vintage condition.

This listing includes a mixed lot of assorted tumbled and raw stones, minerals, and gemstones. The collection features a variety of colors such as green, blue, red, black, white, gray, and brown. Some stones are polished while others remain in their natural form. The stones range from small to medium size and are suitable for collecting, crafting, or educational use. Notable pieces include a blue tumbled stone, a clear quartz-like crystal, snowflake obsidian, and several colorful polished gems. The items are in used, natural condition with typical wear visible on some stones. No specific brand or model is associated with this lot.

description:
This comprehensive geological collection is designed for education, display, and hands-on learning. The set features a blue-framed, multi-compartment specimen display case housing an array of small, curated mineral samples. Accompanying the display box is a detailed reference guide titled "Gemstones and Minerals of the World," which provides a color-coded identification chart for easy classification. Scattered in the foreground is an assortment of larger loose specimens, showcasing various geological textures in both rough, natural states and polished, tumbled finishes. This collection is ideal for classroom learning, hobbyist rockhounds, or young geologists exploring earth sciences.

Early 20th Century

Wahl Signature 14K gold nib (tested and marked)

For more information on Dimensional Weight please visit:(http://www.fedex.com/in/tools/dimweight.html)
3. Paid for items will be shipped as specified within the order and will not be able to be modified or combined.

2. The items close within the same week.

8. FedEx claims are filed on your behalf. We are not responsible for denied claims or delays on FedEx resolutions.
9. There will be a re-shipping fee for items that are returned to sender.

Orthoceras Fossil Specimen Polished Nautiloid Cephalopod Shell Display
This fossil specimen features two Orthoceras fossils embedded in a dark gray to black matrix rock. Orthoceras is an extinct genus of nautiloid cephalopod characterized by long, tapered, conical shells with visible internal chamber lines. The matrix rock is rough and unpolished on the back and sides, while the fossilized shells on the front are polished to a glossy finish, highlighting their natural details and structure. The piece is in excellent natural condition with no visible repairs, suitable for fossil collectors or natural history displays.

Purple Amethyst Druse
1.68 lbs (Total weight)
This striking pair of amethyst crystal specimens features deep purple quartz druse formations. One specimen is professionally mounted on a minimalist black metal display stand, creating a vertical presentation that highlights the crystal's texture and color depth. The second piece is a horizontal cluster showcasing a dense field of faceted crystals atop a natural host rock matrix. Together, they provide a compelling look at the geode-like structures characteristic of high-quality quartz specimens.
Two-piece set including one mounted specimen and one loose cluster
Rich purple coloration with varied crystal sizes and faceted terminations
Includes custom-fitted black metal display stand for the vertical piece
Natural raw matrix backing preserved on both specimens
Condition:

Natural variations in stone matrix and crystal formation are present as expected in raw mineral specimens. No significant damage or repairs observed.

Polished Display Specimen
6" x 2.25" x 3.25"
Unsigned
This striking natural agate geode specimen features a masterfully polished face that reveals intricate concentric banding in shades of teal, seafoam green, and deep cerulean. Cross
Classic Century Pen and Pencil Set - Lustrous Chrome
Vintage 1980s, Ribbed Pinstripe Design
This Cross Classic Century set features the slim, elegant silhouette that has defined the brand's professional writing instruments for decades. description:
Hand Carved Figural Smoking Pipe
Wood Construction with Face Motif
Vintage Folk Art Design
This hand-carved wooden smoking pipe features a distinctive figural face bowl, showcasing a primitive folk art aesthetic. The artisan has utilized the natural grain of the wood to highlight the carved features, creating a unique functional object that doubles as decorative sculpture. These pieces represent a blend of utilitarian craftsmanship and creative folk art traditions.
Hand-carved wooden bowl with a human face motif
Two-piece construction with a removable wooden stem
Natural wood finish showing visible grain and hand-tool marks
Measures approximately 6 inches in length (ruler visible in photos)
Condition:
Good vintage condition with wear consistent with age and use. The wood surface shows natural patina and light surface abrasions. The interior of the bowl shows darkening and residue from previous use. The stem fits securely into the shank. No structural repairs or significant cracks are evident.
